duck_source.what: LEGO Serious Play 'Duck' kit, set 2000416 (6 parts). The kit has no instructions; the exercise is freeform. The assembly copies one duck from a published photo of builds made from the kit.
duck_source.kit_parts: Brickset inventory https://brickset.com/inventories/2000416-1 : Plate 2x3 bright red x2, Brick 2x4 yellow, Brick 2x2 yellow, Brick 1x2 yellow, Brick 2x2 yellow with printed eye
duck_source.photo: https://brickresales.com.au/blogs/blog/lego-serious-play-what-is-the-duck-challenge (feature image; duck at lower middle; used only for a local side-by-side, not redistributed)
duck_source.not_visible_in_photo: the yellow 1x2 (placed as a low tail, our choice); the printed eye is drawn as a decal

parts.name: body
parts.role: 2x4 body across the leg, rear overhangs

parts.name: beak
parts.role: red plate on the front studs, one stud past the body

parts.name: tail
parts.role: 1x2 tail, lying on the rear studs (not visible in the source photo)

conversion: src/vla_forge/duck_ldraw.py: sub-file recursion with BFC winding, LDU 0.4 mm, Y-down to Z-up, origin at the footprint bottom centre. Studs and underside tubes are kept in the visual mesh; physics uses boxes.
